topics.title: The Young-Worker AI Gap
topics.why: Stanford's Digital Economy Lab just found the AI-exposed employment gap for young workers has widened to 19% through mid-2026 -- a concrete, sourced signal about who's actually absorbing the disruption.

topics.title: 56% of CEOs Say Zero ROI on AI -- Here's the Opening
topics.why: WRITER's 2026 adoption survey shows 79% of orgs struggling and 56% of CEOs reporting zero measurable ROI despite $1M+ budgets -- the gap between spend and results is exactly where individual leverage gets built.

topics.title: Agents Everywhere, Scaled Almost Nowhere
topics.why: Nearly 2/3 of enterprises have experimented with AI agents but fewer than 10% have scaled them -- the 'agent ops' skill gap behind that stat is a real, hireable niche right now.

topics.title: Inside the New AI Training Economy
topics.why: DoorDash's new Tasks app and Handshake AI's university-credentialed Fellowship show the gig-to-AI-training pipeline maturing fast, with specialized eval roles now clearing $80+/hr -- directly actionable opportunity-board material.

topics.title: The Market's Softening -- What's Still Hiring Through It
topics.why: BLS data points to a broader labor-market softening again in August alongside a fresh wave of Fortune 500 layoffs citing AI -- worth naming which roles and skills are proving resistant.
